name: Shot Director
description: Direct a cinematic take from one still: pick an open camera preset, describe the shot, and render it on Comfy Cloud with a pinned Wan 2.2 workflow. Every take records its preset, prompt, seed and Comfy job id.

data.comment:
# Shot Director

Turn one still into a directed cinematic take on **Comfy Cloud**.

1. **Source Image**, **Camera Move**, **Direction** and **Seed** feed **Compose Shot**, which looks up the open camera preset (`packages/presets/catalog/camera`) and writes the effective prompt plus a run-settings record.
2. **Run on Comfy Cloud** submits a pinned ComfyUI API workflow (Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B, core ComfyUI nodes only) through the Comfy API v2 SDK. Needs `COMFY_API_KEY`.
3. The take is saved as a video asset. **Comfy Job** carries the job id and output manifest.

Open weights: Wan 2.2 (Apache-2.0). No partner nodes.
